privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Title: 1. Data Obtained from Strava and Purpose of Use
privacy.section1Intro: This service obtains the following data through the Strava API and uses it to provide the turf game.
privacy.section1ProfileDesc: Display name and profile image (icon) — used for identification within groups and for displaying rankings and activity logs.
privacy.section1ActivityDesc: Latitude and longitude contained in running and other activities — used to determine tile capture, defense, and decay based on areas passed through (H3 tiles).
privacy.section1Usage: The above data is used only for running the turf game, displaying group rankings, and displaying Activity Log (history of captures, defenses, etc.). We do not use it for any other purpose.
privacy.section2Body: Obtained data is stored and managed securely on this service's backend (Supabase). We implement standard security measures such as access control and communication encryption (HTTPS) and strive to prevent unauthorized disclosure or leakage to third parties. Permissions obtained from Strava are limited to the minimum scope necessary for the service.
privacy.section3Title: 3. Data Retention & Deletion Upon Account Deletion
privacy.section3Body: Users may delete their own account from the settings screen. Upon account deletion, we delete data associated with that user, including profile information, turf data, and activity logs, in a manner that cannot be recovered. Deletion can be performed via "Account Settings" → "Permanently delete account" within the app.
privacy.section4Body: By using this service, you are deemed to have agreed to the collection, use, and storage of data as described in this Privacy Policy. You must grant the permissions requested by this service (e.g., read profile and activities) on Strava's authorization screen. If you do not agree, you cannot use this service.
privacy.footerNote: This policy may be revised in response to changes in laws or service content. We will notify you through the app or by other appropriate means when material changes are made.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data or activity data with third parties for their marketing or commercial purposes. Data is used solely to operate this service and to provide the turf game features described in this policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Title: 1. Purpose of Service and Use at Your Own Risk
terms.section1Intro: This service provides a turf game that visualizes areas you pass through as "territory" based on running and other activities recorded on Strava. All use of this service is at your own responsibility.
terms.section1DisclaimerIntro: This service is for enjoying running routes and capturing territory. When using the service, you must comply with the following.
terms.section1Rule1Desc: When running, obey road traffic laws and local traffic rules and prioritize safety.
terms.section1Rule2: No entry to dangerous or prohibited areas
terms.section1Rule2Desc: Do not enter private property, restricted areas, construction sites, disaster hazard zones, or any other prohibited or dangerous locations. We are not responsible for any accidents or incidents arising from unreasonable route choices for the purpose of capturing territory.
terms.section1Rule3Desc: You are responsible for guarding against heat stroke, falls, suspicious persons, and the like. Use the service within reasonable limits.
terms.section1Violation: We cannot be held responsible for use that violates the above or for any damage arising therefrom.
terms.section2Body: This service uses Strava OAuth for authentication. To start using the service, you must link your Strava account and grant the permissions requested by this service. Please also comply with Strava's terms of service and privacy policy. Group participation is only possible via invitation links. Account deletion can be performed from the app's settings screen; after deletion, your data will be erased.
terms.section3CheatDesc: Submitting false location data, using unauthorized tools or scripts, or registering tampered Strava data, or any other conduct that undermines fair gameplay.
terms.section3ApiDesc: Use that violates Strava's API terms of use, excessive requests, or accessing the service by impersonating others.
terms.section3Other: Any other conduct that violates laws or Strava's terms of service, or that causes trouble or harm to other users or third parties.
terms.section3Enforce: If conduct that falls under prohibited items is confirmed, we may take measures such as suspending or deleting the account.
terms.section4DisclaimerBody: This service is provided "as is." We are not liable for any suspension, modification, or malfunction of the service, or for any damage arising from use. As stated above, any accidents or incidents arising from use of the location-based game are the user's own responsibility.
terms.section4ChangesBody: These terms may be changed as necessary. When material changes are made, we will notify you through the app or by other appropriate means. If you use the service on or after the effective date of the revised terms, you are deemed to have agreed to the revised terms.
terms.footerNote: These terms are governed by the laws of Japan. Any dispute concerning this service shall be subject to the exclusive agreed jurisdiction of the court having jurisdiction over the operator's principal place of business.

settings.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your account will permanently remove all your turf data, group memberships, and activity logs. This action cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Your account will be permanently deleted. All data including turf data will be removed. This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?

landing.headline: Run, and the city
landing.subhead: Capture areas you run through on Strava as "territory." Compete with friends, defend, and watch colors decay while ghosts remain.
landing.featuresTitle: The turf game starts when you run
landing.feature1Desc: Tiles you pass through become yours instantly. Run the same route again to defend and reset the color.
landing.feature2Desc: Score decays linearly over 30 days after capture. The color fades but your icon remains as a ghost.
landing.feature3Desc: Share the map with friends who join via invite links. Compete on capture logs and rankings.
landing.finalCtaDesc: We only read your running data from Strava. Turf updates automatically.
